# gtk4 codegen must produce compilable cgo. `sngl build` compiles the generated
# C/cgo to a binary without running it, so it needs no display — this guards the
# gtk4 codegen in CI, where the render-based snapshot script (test_gtk4_snapshot)
# skips for lack of an X11/Wayland display.

[!exec:go] skip 'go toolchain required'
[!exec:pkg-config] skip 'pkg-config required'
[!exec:cc] skip 'C compiler required for cgo'
[!gtk4] skip 'gtk4 development libraries required'

sngl build --platform=gtk4 --lang=go app.sngl -o out
exists out/app

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import app "sngl:app"

output { go { gtk4 } }

component greeter ui {
    var name = "world"
    text(value=name)
}

app.window {
}
